d: What really happened during Sandpapergate, and why is Australian cricket still struggling to move on? Jason Gillespie, a former Australia fast bowler who knows that dressing room from the inside, speaks exclusively to Firstpost’s Sports Editor Rupha Ramani about the renewed controversy surrounding the 2018 ball-tampering scandal. Gillespie discusses the conflicting accounts that have emerged, why he believes Cricket Australia's original investigation fell short, and whether the punishments handed to Smith, Warner and Bancroft were disproportionately harsh.
